evidence: 100% of the hotel name appears on the page

verified_facts.text: The resort rises from the slopes of Sulphur Mountain, above the forest canopy.
verified_facts.excerpt: Above the forest canopy, where mountain air runs clear and horizons stretch without end, Rimrock Banff, Emblems Collection rises from the slopes of Sulphur Mountain.

verified_facts.text: The resort is surrounded by Banff National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage site.
verified_facts.excerpt: a retreat surrounded by the wild expanse of Banff National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage site

verified_facts.text: Rimrock Banff is the first Emblems Collection hotel in North America.
verified_facts.excerpt: As the first Emblems Collection hotel in North America, The Rimrock Banff is shaped by nature

verified_facts.text: The resort sits above the valley, moments from Banff Upper Hot Springs and the Banff Gondola.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled above the valley and just moments from Banff Upper Hot Springs and the Banff Gondola

verified_facts.text: The resort is just over 1.5 hours west of Calgary International Airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: Just over 1.5 hours west of Calgary International Airport, we invite you to experience the awe-inspiring beauty of the Banff National Park from our elevated retreat on Sulphur Mountain.

verified_facts.text: The Infinity Two Bedroom Suite is a top-level suite with an expansive balcony overlooking the Rockies.
verified_facts.excerpt: this elevated, top-level suite is a home away from home featuring upscale amenities, fine furnishings, and an expansive balcony overlooking the Rockies.

verified_facts.text: The Wellness Studio with Private Terrace has Technogym equipment, Hyperice tools, aromatherapy and Canadian wellness amenities.
verified_facts.excerpt: With Technogym equipment, Hyperice tools, aromatherapy, and curated Canadian wellness amenities, it offers a sanctuary for movement, stillness, and renewal high above the forested slopes of Banff.

verified_facts.text: Premium Forest View rooms have views of Mount Rundle and the Bow Valley.
verified_facts.excerpt: Featuring sweeping views of Mount Rundle and the incredible Bow Valley, these Premium Forest View guest rooms offer upscale design elements and curated amenities.

verified_facts.text: The resort has pet-friendly accommodations.
verified_facts.excerpt: At Rimrock Banff, our pet-friendly accommodations ensure your four-legged companions can share in the adventure.

verified_facts.text: With the Aurora Wake-Up Call, guests can sign up to be called and woken if the northern lights appear during their stay.
verified_facts.excerpt: With our Aurora Wake-Up Call, you can sign up to be notified if the northern lights make an appearance during your stay. Our team will give you a call and wake you up

verified_facts.text: In winter, the Rimrock Ski Connector takes guests to Banff's ski hills, with a stop at the Banff Springs Hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Ski Connector makes getting to Banff's top ski hills a breeze. With a quick and convenient stop at the Banff Springs Hotel

verified_facts.text: Mountain Goat Adventures offers private guided hikes led by certified guide Jeff Douglas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Step off the grid and into the wild with private guided hikes through Banff's most awe-inspiring terrain. Led by certified guide Jeff Douglas

verified_facts.text: The resort has a Bathhouse and Fitness facility.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bathhouse & Fitness Let the awe-inspiring Banff National Park and the surrounding Canadian Rockies set the scene for your continued journey to wellness.

verified_facts.text: Personal training is offered in all seasons.
verified_facts.excerpt: All Season #### Personal Training

verified_facts.text: Parker's Table is the signature restaurant, celebrating Canadian terroir.
verified_facts.excerpt: Parker's Table is the signature dining experience at Rimrock Banff, a celebration of Canadian terroir and the true North.

verified_facts.text: Rimrock Market serves craft beers, cocktails and house-made gelato, with seasonal programming such as fireside Bombardino evenings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Craft beers and cocktails flow from the taps, signature plates and house made gelato make their rounds, and seasonal programming keeps the space lively, from happy hour to fireside Bombardino evenings.

verified_facts.text: As the day unfolds, Social becomes an apres hub with music and crafted drinks.
verified_facts.excerpt: As the day unfolds, it transforms into an après hub, where the air hums with music, conversation, and the artistry of crafted drinks shared among friends.

verified_facts.text: The Listening Lounge pairs music and crafted drinks in an intimate setting.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Listening Lounge at Rimrock Banff is an intimate retreat where music, ambiance, and crafted drinks create an atmosphere of quiet sophistication.

verified_facts.text: Golf is played off-site at Fairmont Banff Springs, on 18, 9 or all 27 holes, in spring, summer and fall.
verified_facts.excerpt: Golf in the middle of Banff National Park on a 18-hole, 9-hole or all 27 holes at Fairmont Banff Springs in the Spring, Summer and Fall.

verified_facts.text: The resort runs a Green Program to reduce its environmental impact.
verified_facts.excerpt: we're reducing our impact on the environment through our Green Program.

verified_facts.text: The Studio King Room has expansive mountain views and a spacious layout.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Studio King Room with Peak Views offers space, light, and perspective. Expansive mountain vistas connect the wild beauty outside with the calm within

verified_facts.text: This perch high in the Canadian Rockies has drawn explorers and wellness seekers for over a century.
verified_facts.excerpt: For over a century, this perch high in the Canadian Rockies has been a place where wonder meets stillness, where explorers, dreamers, and seekers of wellness have found renewal in the mountains.

unresolved.text: The resort has 320 guestrooms and suites.
Conde Nast Traveler lists the hotel in its Readers' Choice Awards 2020.

contradictions.note: p2 (official) says 320 guestrooms and suites; p8 (Conde Nast Traveler) lists 333 rooms

sources.excerpt: Our collection of 320 guestrooms and suites offers more than comfort
